sinirlar.alinti: Boundary: for a single continuous line with off-register colour patches use `illustration-one-line`; for thick brush outlines with a second flat ink use `illustration-two-colour-brush`; for thin indigo interiors with sparse colour accents use `illustration-line-interior`.
